hints.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence Dual Scans
hints.text: A mountain array increases to a peak then decreases. Compute longest increasing subsequence ending at each index.

hints.title: Longest Decreasing Subsequence from Right
hints.text: Compute longest decreasing subsequence starting at each index (increasing subsequence from right to left).

hints.title: Valid Mountain Peak Criteria
hints.text: A valid peak must have both ascending and descending length strictly greater than 1.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Quadratic O(n^2) dynamic programming can be slow for larger arrays.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search patience sorting computes prefix/suffix LIS arrays in O(n log n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate enforces lis_left[i] > 1 and lis_right[i] > 1 to guarantee a non-empty slope on both sides.

solutions.approach: Dual LIS using binary search and peak maximization
